messages:
morgan: Heads-up: sprint-22 release train is Wed 09:00 PT. Were doing a region canary (us-west1) at 09:00 then stagger to other regions every +30m. Need explicit owners for each slot + whos doing smoke signoffs and rollback readiness. Slots I have so far: DB-migration, model-service, api-proxy, embeddings.
lee: I can take api-proxy @09:40. Will validate header passthrough and rate-limit rules.
tia: I'll own DB-migration @09:00 canary. Doing a dry-run tonight on staging and will prepare the pt-restore rollback steps.
samir: model-service @09:20 for me. Quick Q: do we want canary circuit-breaker at 3 errors or 5? For model loads I'm leaning 5 to avoid noisy false-positives.
morgan: For canary be strict: 3 errors within 2m triggers auto-pause. Normal rollout lanes keep 6. Also auto-pause must notify #eng-oncall immediately.
lee: ack. I'll enable auto-pause and hook alerts to eng-oncall. Also smoke script: /ops/smoke/api-proxy.sh -> will run after each region window.
alex: I'll do smoke signoff for each slot. Plan to run:
1) GET /health -> 200
2) one end-to-end request for common flow -> success and latency < 500ms
3) quick logs check for any 5xx spikes
I'll post like: "smoke: api-proxy: green (09:47)" or "smoke: api-proxy: red (09:47)"
deploy-bot: scheduled release-train:sprint-22 at 1876635600 (Wed 09:00 PT). Slots: DB-migration@09:00 (tia), model-service@09:20 (samir), api-proxy@09:40 (lee), embeddings@10:10 (unassigned).
tia: backup snapshot path: gs://redwood-releases/backups/sprint22-db-2026-04-xx. Dry-run tonight; rollback plan is pt-restore + revert schema by feature-flag. I can trigger revert within ~8m once decision made.
samir: embeddings still needs owner. I can extend if no one else volunteers. I'll prepare canary dataset and perf check script:
```bash
# quick perf check
curl -s -X POST https://canary.internal/embeds -d '{"text":"hello"}' | jq '.latency'
```
Ill post results in-thread.
lee: pre-deploy checklist I'll finish by EOD:
- confirm no hard DB migrations (backwards compatible)
- snapshot created
- smoke script verified on staging
- alerting configured to eng-oncall
morgan: If any canary window goes red we pause and rollback immediately per policy. Do not wait for multiple failures. Owners should be ready to rollback.
alex: Ill be on smoke duty from 09:00-11:30 PT. If I mark red Ill DM owners and SRE.
lee: ack will run prechecks tonight, setting a REMINDER in calendar.
tia: ack backup + rollback rehearsed; staying on pager until 11:00 PT.
samir: ack canary dataset uploaded, perf script ready.
deploy-bot: reminder: canary window starts in ~18h.
morgan: Thanks everyone. Final ask: post a quick "prechecks done" reply in this thread by EOD so I can close the loop and notify prod-eng for extra eyes during canary. :pray:
